Subject: Your tenancy eviction matter - R.C.A. No. 2041/2025

Dear Mr. Rane,

Thank you for meeting us on 23 October 2025 about your dispute with Leena Natarajan. As we understand it, the tenant has stopped paying rent for many months.

Our advice is to issue a notice terminating the tenancy and claim mesne profits for the period of occupation. Please collect the rent agreement, the rent receipts and the notice terminating the tenancy and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
